title.en: Fifty-seven operations, thirty-two with envelopes, one legacy placeholder

goal.en: Read the operation vocabulary from the hub: 57 entries, 32 of which carry a thermal envelope with a sensor ladder; the last is cw.op.legacy_step, the placeholder for unclassified V0 imports (RFC-0009).

note.en: Deep frying's envelope: oil between 160 and 190 degrees C, one rung on the ladder (an oil thermometer), never unattended.
Dispensing has no envelope: envelopes belong to operations that heat, cool or hold.

outcome.en: You know where envelopes live and which operation an importer uses when it cannot classify a step. Next: 094 and 095 validate the supply and fleet documents.
